title: [DOCS] Document new mascot 'Clawd' and implement an introductory welcome screen
body: ### Documentation Type Missing documentation (feature not documented) ### Documentation Location The Claude Code extension within Visual Studio Code. The issue is present on the initial screen when opening a new Claude chat session. ### Section/Topic The initial user onboarding experience and general product documentation. There is no mention of the product's mascot, which creates a disconnect with recent branding efforts. ### Current Documentation When a new Claude Code session is started in VS Code, the screen is mostly empty, with the following text: Make a CLAUDE.md file for instructions Claude will read every single time. There is no other introductory text, branding, or character presented to the user. ### What's Wrong or Missing? The official Claude Code social media has introduced a new mascot named "Clawd" 🦀 (see link in Additional Context). However, this mascot is completely absent from the product itself and any accompanying documentation. This results in: A missed opportunity to build brand identity and make the tool more approachable. A disconnect between the marketing/community presence and the actual user experience. The initial welcome screen is stark and could be more engaging for new users. ### Suggested Improvement We suggest two improvements: 1. Implement an In-Product Welcome Screen: Instead of a blank screen, display a welcome message featuring the new mascot, Clawd, when a user starts a new session for the first time or when the chat history is empty. This would greatly improve the onboarding experience. Suggested Text/Concept: The screen could feature an image of Clawd with a welcome message, such as: "Hi, my name is Clawd. How I can help you today?" 2. Update Official Documentation: Add a section to the official Claude Code documentation that introduces Clawd. This could be in an "About" section or as part of the "Getting Started" guide to formally introduce the character to users. ### Impact High - Prevents users from using a feature ### Additional Context Screenshots showing the issue: Current empty state in VS Code: Example of a proposed welcome screen featuring Clawd: Links to related documentation: Official social media post introducing Clawd: [https://x.com/trq212/status/1972784970054893877](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Ftrq212%2Fstatus%2F1972784970054893877) Examples from other projects that do this well: Many developer tools use mascots or friendly onboarding screens to establish a brand and make the initial experience more pleasant. GitHub's Octocat is a prime example of successful mascot integration. This would be a similar, positive step for Claude Code. Proposed New
author: coygeek

top_comments.author: AndreasBaumgart
top_comments.body:
Hey, I literally asked myself the exact same question just now when I opened Claude Code.
I especially think it’s important (and kind of fascinating) to explain the biological nature of Clawd — which seems to be somewhere between an octopus and a gelatinous creature. Those details really matter for the allegorical potential and could massively influence the memes coming up next year.
